site.name: Magick.ly
site.description: A magick and occult reference app with study tools and a ritual editor.
site.audience: Practitioners and readers studying Western esoteric traditions.
site.tone: Clear, precise and respectful; distinguish evidence from interpretation.

rules: Keep source titles, citations, author names, licence identifiers and machine-readable names intact.
Translate first-party interface and explanatory prose only. Source works, quotations and stored rituals retain their own languages.
The Enochian tools continue to work in English and Enochian; localizing controls does not change dictionary data or tool working languages.

scopes.description: Enochian reference material, dictionary, Keys and tablets.

scopes.title: Enochian translator
scopes.description: A dictionary-based tool looking up words in both directions between English and Enochian.
Save, copy and link controls under a drawing, one row per file format, and a last row, 'This page', that shares a link to the page itself. SVG, PNG and PDF are file formats and stay in Latin letters.
Shared navigation, language settings, search, Share (the app bar's button and the export box's 'This page' row, which say the same) and homepage links.

scopes.title: Temples
scopes.description: Group membership, invitations, access management and forum synchronization.
Ritual editing, reading, recovery and offline controls; stored ritual text is separate content.
Public page titles and descriptions; preserve source-work names and attribution.
